title: Hopewind string-inverter protocol 567 / 0237 V100B002D000
summary: Manufacturer protocol for 3–80 kW string inverters: FC03 telemetry blocks 40500–40650 and FC06 power settings. Implemented untested writes are 40002 reactive mode, 40011 active mode, and 40013 active ratio (0–100%, 0.01% scaling). Other settings are not exposed as writes.
